item.title: Refineries have shifted production away from gasoline to middle distillates

evidence_spans.text: Petroleum refinery yields represent the share of a specific fuel that is produced from each barrel of crude oil a given refinery (or group of refineries) processes. Refinery yields of jet fuel have also been relatively high this year. The U.S. refinery fleet exceeded an average jet fuel yield of 12% for the first time in March 2026, according to EIA data.
